description: A vulnerability was detected in Portábilis i-Educar up to 2.7.5. Affected is an unknown function of the file \intranet\agenda_imprimir.php of the component HTTP GET Request Handler. The manipulation of the argument cod_agenda with the input ");'> <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> results in cross site scripting. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading the affected component is recommended. The vendor explains: "This endpoint and the associated functionality are no longer present in the current i-Educar codebase, as the affected area was removed from the product. As a result, the previously reported attack vector (...) is no longer applicable to versions in which this functionality has been removed."
